_about: Teach-back (Feynman technique). Audiences and lengths rotate so explaining an idea never feels like the same exercise twice. Interface wording only: no historical claims live here. Typed answers are saved with their date and are never scored; the player self-rates, and that rating only moves the idea's next review.
